# Intake Brief — Herdr stage vocabulary out of sync with wl CLI (WL-0MU624MF7004WYMI)

## Problem Statement

The Herdr plugin still enumerates two stage values that the `wl` CLI no longer
accepts (`in_progress`, `completed`) and omits nothing for `done` any more, but
its display and filter paths were only partially brought in line. The result
is a stage filter that can select stages with no (`in_progress`/`completed`)
backing data and shows misleading empty worklists, and code paths that key off
`stage === 'in_progress'` semantics that no longer exist in the CLI vocabulary.

## Users

- **Herdr plugin users (developers / agents)** browsing with the `f i/f n/f p/f r`
  stage-filter chords or `/wl <stage>`, who currently hit dead filter states.
- **Producers / reviewers** relying on the Herdr list to reflect the same
  pipeline stages as `wl` and the Pi TUI, so an item's stage means the same
  thing everywhere.
- **Maintainers** of the shared icon/colour maps, who need the stage vocabulary
  to be a single source of truth.

### Example User Stories

- As a **Herdr user**, I want the stage filter to cycle only through stages the
  CLI actually recognises (`idea`, `intake_complete`, `plan_complete`,
  `in_review`, `done`), so I never land on a filter that can only ever be empty.
- As a **Herdr user**, I want legacy items carrying `stage=done` (2,355 in the
  current DB) to render the completed-style checkmark rather than a fallback
  question mark.
- As a **Herdr user**, I want an item being actively worked (its `status` is
  `in-progress`) to keep the metadata Last-command panel even though its
  `stage` is `plan_complete`/`intake_complete`.
- As a **maintainer**, I want the Herdr stage vocabulary to be derived from (or
  asserted equal to) the shared `wl` stage rules, so it cannot drift again.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `packages/herdr/src/worklist.ts` `STAGES` equals exactly the CLI
      vocabulary `['idea','intake_complete','plan_complete','in_review','done']`
      (`in_progress` and `completed` removed); `Stage` (and any derived types)
      continue to typecheck, and no Herdr code hard-codes the removed values as
      valid stages.
- [ ] `STAGE_MAP` accepts only the CLI-valid canonical names and supported
      shorthand aliases; the `progress → in_progress` alias is removed, while
      `intake`/`plan`/`review`/`done` aliases still resolve. `/wl progress` and
      `/wl completed` fail soft (no crash, no invalid filter applied) consistent
      with the existing `/wl <bogus>` behaviour.
- [ ] `StageFilter` cycles only the five valid stages (then clears to `null`);
      `fetchItemsByStage` guards unknown/invalid stages fail-soft so it never
      issues `wl list --stage <invalid>` and never throws (returns an empty or
      fallback list). A regression test proves `in_progress`/`completed`/
      `bogus` cannot produce a CLI invocation and do not throw.
- [ ] Herdr behaviour that previously keyed off `stage === 'in_progress'` (the
      list-row stage tag suppression, the metadata-panel Last-command
      reservation and lookup) is re-based on `status === 'in-progress'`, so
      actively-worked items keep the same UI behaviour under the current
      status-only claim model.
- [ ] The shared icon/colour maps (`packages/shared/src/icons.ts`
      `STAGE_ICONS`/`STAGE_FALLBACK`/`stageColor`) include `done` mapped to the
      completed-style checkmark/colour, and every valid stage plus an unknown
      stage render deterministically (unknown falls back to the question-mark
      icon without throwing). New/updated tests cover `done` and an unknown
      stage.
- [ ] Tests are added/updated for: the exact `STAGES` list, `StageFilter`
      cycling/wrapping, `STAGE_MAP` alias resolution and invalid-alias
      fail-soft, `fetchItemsByStage` invalid-stage guarding, and status-based
      in-progress UI behaviour; all existing tests continue to pass.
- [ ] All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including
      code comments, `packages/herdr/README.md`, and any relevant `CLI.md` /
      docs entries describing the Herdr stage vocabulary and filter chords.
      (CHANGELOG.md is excluded — managed by the ship release pipeline.)
- [ ] Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.

## Constraints

- **Align to the CLI, do not change it.** The `wl` stage vocabulary is
  `idea`, `intake_complete`, `plan_complete`, `in_review`, `done`
  (`.worklog/config.defaults.yaml:21-31`). Do not add stages to `wl` config as
  part of this work item.
- **Preserve legacy rendering.** 2,355 persisted items carry `stage=done`; the
  plugin must keep rendering them correctly. `done` must remain a displayable
  stage even though it is the post-release terminal stage.
- **Support legacy `stage=in_progress` rows fail-soft.** The current DB has one
  `stage=in_progress` item; removing the value from `STAGES` must not crash any
  code path that renders it.
- **Status semantics unchanged.** `status=in-progress` remains the "actively
  worked" signal (SA-0MTFTFUIH000UWM9); do not reintroduce a stage for it.
- **No scope creep into `wl` core** (config/validation/doctor) — those were
  handled by WL-0MTOHS5B4001Y9FX; this item is the Herdr/shared-display
  follow-up only.
- Respect `.gitignore` / agent-framework ignore rules in searches.

## Existing State

- **CLI valid stages** (`npx tsx`/config inspection of
  `.worklog/config.defaults.yaml:21-31`):
  `idea, intake_complete, plan_complete, in_review, done`. `in_progress` and
  `completed` are not accepted by `wl update`/`wl next` validation
  (`src/commands/status-stage-validation.ts:76`).
- **Herdr `STAGES`** (`packages/herdr/src/worklist.ts:166-174`):
  `idea, intake_complete, plan_complete, in_progress, in_review, completed,
  done` — two invalid values present (added as legacy alias handling in
  WL-0MU3U1AMP0044WUX).
- **Herdr `STAGE_MAP`** (`worklist.ts:180-194`) includes `progress →
  in_progress` and self-mappings for `in_progress`/`done`.
- **`STAGE_STATUS`** (`packages/herdr/src/fetcher.ts:632-636`) only special-cases
  `in_review`, `plan_complete`, `intake_complete`; anything else defaults to
  `--status open`, so `fetchItemsByStage('in_progress'|'completed')` issues
  `wl list --status open --stage in_progress|completed --root-only` and returns
  an empty, misleading list.
- **`stage === 'in_progress'` keyed behaviour** remains in
  `worklist.ts:1355` (row stage-tag suppression), `worklist.ts:2020-2026`
  (metadata Last-command reservation), and `worklist.ts:6252` (last-command
  lookup). These predate the stage removal and now never fire for
  status-only claims.
- **Shared icons** (`packages/shared/src/icons.ts:51-68, 608-617`) already
  include `done` keys (added by WL-0MU3U1AMP0044WUX) but still carry
  `in_progress`/`completed` stage entries.
- **DB stage distribution** (measured `wl list --json`): `done` 2,355,
  `in_review` 6, `intake_complete` 14, `idea` 45, `plan_complete` 2,
  `in_progress` 1 (status `blocked`), `completed` 0.
- **Research note:** the seed's claim that `wl list --stage <invalid>` raises a
  CLI error was **not reproducible** in the current build — `wl list --stage
  bogus`/`--stage completed` return `success:true, count:0`. The defect is
  therefore a misleading empty filter plus a missing fail-soft guard, not a
  hard CLI error. (The validation error is real for `wl update`.)

## Desired Change

- Replace Herdr's `STAGES` with the exact CLI vocabulary
  `['idea','intake_complete','plan_complete','in_review','done']` and update
  the `Stage` type/consumers accordingly.
- Trim `STAGE_MAP` to CLI-valid names plus shorthand aliases; drop the
  `progress`/`in_progress` alias (and any `completed` mapping).
- Make `fetchItemsByStage` fail-soft for unknown/invalid stages: do not invoke
  `wl` with an invalid `--stage`, return an empty (or sensible fallback) list,
  and never throw.
- Re-base `stage === 'in_progress'` UI behaviour on `status === 'in-progress'`.
- Confirm/retain `done` in `STAGE_ICONS`/`STAGE_FALLBACK`/`stageColor` and add
  regression coverage for `done` and unknown stages.
- Prefer deriving `STAGES` from the shared status-stage rules (or assert
  equality against them in a test) so future drift is caught.
- Update `tests/herdr/worklist.test.ts`, `tests/herdr/fetcher.test.ts`,
  `packages/herdr/src/stage-status.test.ts`, `tests/herdr/icons.test.ts`, and
  any other test asserting the old seven-stage list.

## Key Files (predicted)

- `packages/herdr/src/worklist.ts` — `STAGES` (line ~166) and `STAGE_MAP`
  (line ~180) trimmed to the CLI vocabulary; `StageFilter`; `stage ===
  'in_progress'` branches at lines ~1355, ~2020, ~6252 re-based on status;
  `/wl <stage>` help/list options at ~2522, ~3275, ~3453.
- `packages/herdr/src/fetcher.ts` — `STAGE_STATUS` (line ~632) and
  `fetchItemsByStage` (line ~658) fail-soft guard for invalid stages.
- `packages/shared/src/icons.ts` — verify/retain `done` entries in
  `STAGE_ICONS`/`STAGE_FALLBACK`/`stageColor`; ensure unknown-stage fallback
  is deterministic.
- `packages/herdr/src/stage-status.test.ts` — extend coverage for invalid
  stages and the removed `completed`/`in_progress` cases.
- `tests/herdr/worklist.test.ts` — update the `STAGES` equality assertion
  (line ~289), `StageFilter` cycling/set tests, `in_progress` fixture
  semantics.
- `tests/herdr/fetcher.test.ts` — update `fetchItemsByStage('in_progress')`
  and `'completed'` expectations (lines ~269, ~280-286).
- `tests/herdr/icons.test.ts` — stage-list fixtures (lines ~74, ~186) and
  `done`/unknown-stage icon coverage.
- `packages/herdr/README.md` (and `CLI.md` if it documents the Herdr stage
  vocabulary/filter chords) — document the aligned vocabulary.

## Related Work

- **WL-0MTOHS5B4001Y9FX — Remove the in_progress stage** (completed): removed
  `in_progress` from `wl` config/validation; this item is the Herdr/shared
  follow-up that the stage removal implied.
- **WL-0MU3U1AMP0044WUX — Herdr extension selection list: icons sometimes render
  as error (?)** (completed): added the `done` legacy alias to `STAGES`,
  `STAGE_MAP` and the shared icon maps; this item finishes the vocabulary
  alignment for the remaining invalid values.
- **Potentially related docs:** `.worklog/config.defaults.yaml`
  (`stages` list), `src/commands/status-stage-validation.ts`,
  `src/status-stage-rules.ts`, `packages/shared/src/icons.ts`.
- **Potentially related work items:** `WL-0MQJGBSUS0057EI4` — Add
  ready_to_merge stage support to workflow config (completed; stage-vocabulary
  precedent); `WL-0MQRC8FFC007NNTD` / `WL-0MQRC8BE90048RHA` — status-only claim
  pattern; `WL-0MSAR110S002V26K` — Herdr grouping rules involving in_progress.

## Risks & Assumptions

- **Risk — hidden `stage === 'in_progress'` coupling:** additional branches may
  key off the removed stage beyond those listed; mitigation: repo-wide grep for
  `in_progress`/`completed` stage usage and cover with tests.
- **Risk — display regression for legacy `in_progress` items:** the single
  persisted `stage=in_progress` item must render fail-soft; mitigation: explicit
  unknown/legacy-stage test asserting the fallback icon, no throw.
- **Risk — test fixtures encode the old vocabulary:** many Herdr tests use
  `stage: 'in_progress'` as a convenient fixture; mitigation: migrate fixtures
  to valid stages/status so tests reflect the real domain.
- **Risk — `/wl progress` user muscle-memory:** removing the alias makes it fail
  soft; mitigation: document the change in `packages/herdr/README.md`.
- **Risk — scope creep into `wl` core:** temptation to re-add an
  `in_progress`-equivalent stage or refactor the whole stage model; mitigation:
  out of scope — record as a new work item if proposed.
- **Assumption:** status-only in-progress (`status === 'in-progress'`) is the
  correct replacement signal for the removed `in_progress` stage in UI
  (confirmed by WL-0MTOHS5B4001Y9FX).
- **Assumption:** Herdr may import from `packages/shared` (already does for
  icons), so deriving `STAGES` from shared rules is feasible; if it proves
  awkward, a test asserting equality against the shared rules is an acceptable
  fallback.

## Appendix: Clarifying Questions & Answers

- Q: "Should the interview ask the producer to confirm the target stage
  vocabulary?" — Answer: Not asked. The seed context plus repo inspection
  establishes the CLI vocabulary unambiguously as
  `idea, intake_complete, plan_complete, in_review, done`
  (`.worklog/config.defaults.yaml:21-31`), so no producer input is required.
  Source: `wl` config inspection; WL-0MTOHS5B4001Y9FX intake brief.
- Q: "Should `in_progress`/`completed` be kept as legacy display-only aliases
  like `done`?" — Answer: Not asked; the work-item seed explicitly asks to
  "align STAGES with the CLI vocabulary" and the shared icon maps already cover
  legacy rendering via fallbacks. Assumption: remove both from `STAGES`/
  `STAGE_MAP`; keep fail-soft rendering for legacy data. Source:
  WL-0MU624MF7004WYMI description; `packages/shared/src/icons.ts`.
- Q: "Does the reported CLI error on invalid `--stage` still reproduce?" —
  Answer (research): No. `wl list --stage bogus` and `--stage completed` both
  return `success:true, count:0` in the current build; the real defect is a
  misleading empty filter plus the missing fail-soft guard. Source: direct
  `wl list` runs against the repo DB.
- Q: "Is the in-progress UI behaviour (Last command panel, stage-tag
  suppression) still needed?" — Answer (research): Yes, but it must key off
  `status === 'in-progress'` rather than the removed `stage === 'in_progress'`
  per WL-0MTOHS5B4001Y9FX's status-only claim model. Source:
  `packages/herdr/src/worklist.ts:1355,2020-2026,6252`.


## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **WL-0MQJGBSUS0057EI4** – Add ready_to_merge stage support to workflow config (completed)
- **WL-0MN77789Q1LZ93N4** – Failing test: in-progress boost / reSort - ancestor boost when in-progress child is completed (tests/database.test.ts) (completed)
- **WL-0MSGAEC5N006W5QA** – Wire read commands through cache; spawn instrumentation (completed)

### Repository file matches
- `packages/herdr/README.md` — matched: align, also, back, cli, complete, completed, current, data, error, fail, fall, fallback, filter, fix, found, guard, herdr, icon, icons, idea, intake, invalid, issues, items, key, legacy, list, lists, map, maps, mark, metadata, missing, need, note, packages, path, plan, progress, question, render, renders, review, shared, should, src, stage, stages, status, style, sync, their, update, valid, verified, via, work, worklist
- `CHANGELOG.md` — matched: 0mu3u1amp0044wux, align, also, back, cli, complete, completed, current, data, error, fail, fall, fallback, filter, fix, found, guard, herdr, icon, icons, idea, intake, invalid, issues, items, key, legacy, list, lists, map, mark, metadata, missing, need, note, packages, path, plan, progress, question, render, renders, review, shared, should, src, stage, status, style, sync, their, update, valid, via, work, worklist
- `CLI.md` — matched: also, back, cli, complete, completed, current, data, discovered, error, fail, fall, fallback, filter, fix, found, guard, herdr, icon, icons, idea, intake, invalid, issues, items, key, legacy, list, lists, mark, metadata, missing, need, note, omits, path, plan, progress, question, render, renders, review, shared, should, soft, src, stage, stages, status, style, sync, their, update, valid, via, work

# Effort and Risk Report

## Effort Estimate

- **T-shirt size:** Small
- **Three-point (PERT):** O=5.50h, M=11.50h, P=21.00h
- **Expected (E=(O+4M+P)/6):** 12.08h
- **Recommended (with overheads):** 18.08h
- **Range:** [11.50h — 27.00h]
- **Unit:** hours

### Work Breakdown Structure (WBS)

| # | Item | O (h) | M (h) | P (h) | Expected (h) |
|---|------|-------|-------|-------|-------------|
| 1 | Align STAGES / STAGE_MAP / StageFilter with CLI vocabulary | 1.00 | 2.00 | 4.00 | 2.17 |
| 2 | Re-base stage==='in_progress' UI behaviour on status==='in-progress' | 1.00 | 2.00 | 3.00 | 2.00 |
| 3 | Fail-soft guard for fetchItemsByStage invalid stages | 0.50 | 1.50 | 3.00 | 1.58 |
| 4 | Verify/retain done + unknown-stage handling in shared icons | 0.50 | 1.00 | 2.00 | 1.08 |
| 5 | Update/extend Herdr + icons tests for the new vocabulary | 2.00 | 4.00 | 7.00 | 4.17 |
| 6 | Update Herdr README / CLI docs for the aligned vocabulary | 0.50 | 1.00 | 2.00 | 1.08 |


## Risk Assessment

- **Risk Score:** 10/25 — **Medium**
- **Probability:** 3.16/5 | **Impact:** 3.16/5

### Top Risk Drivers & Mitigations

1. **Stage vocabulary alignment** — Add targeted tests and integration checks
2. **Status-based in-progress UI rewrite** — Lock dependencies and add compatibility tests
3. **Broad test churn from fixture migration** — Schedule extra review for risky components


## Confidence

- **Confidence:** 74%
- **Unknowns:** Whether additional Herdr code paths key off the removed in_progress/completed stage beyond those identified by grep.; Whether CLI.md currently documents the Herdr stage vocabulary or only the wl CLI vocabulary.
- **Assumptions:** Status-only in-progress (status === 'in-progress') is the correct replacement signal for the removed in_progress stage in UI.; Herdr may import from packages/shared (already does for icons), so STAGES can be derived from / asserted against the shared stage rules.; The shared icon maps already carry 'done'; only regression coverage is needed there.
